title: Velocity Spindle — weekly journal and micro-experiments
content:
Purpose: Compact weekly scratchpad to keep my objectives aligned with product impact while running small experiments on focus, throughput, and quality control. Not intended to be polished — quick reads for my future self.

North-star (personal): Increase measurable product impact per week — operationalized as 'impact units' (see scoring below).

Quarter OKRs (Q3 2025) — my draft:
- O1: Launch two quality gating experiments that reduce regression surface on hosted-api by 15% (key metric: eval-regressions/week).
  - KR1: Define and run 4 prompt-eval sets (priority: chat-short, code-completion)
  - KR2: Automation pipeline to flag nondeterministic regressions for quick rollback
- O2: Improve my personal throughput on end-to-end features from ideation->PR by 25%
  - KR1: Reduce average cycle time on assigned PRs from 5.2d -> 3.9d
  - KR2: Ship at least 3 small improvements with measurable perf uplift

Weekly snapshot (week starting 2025-09-01):
- Focus theme: 'Experiment fidelity' — build a tiny harness to isolate prompt-layer flakiness.
- Top 3 commitments (Sprint spindle):
  1) Draft evaluation harness + run baseline (2–3h)
  2) Pair with Priya to triage last week's nondet alerts (90m)
  3) Ship README + two smoke tests for the harness (2h)

Energy wedges (time budgeting, rough):
- Deep work: 7h (blocks M/Tu/Th morning)
- Sync / pairing: 3.5h
- Review & shallow tasks: 4h
- Buffer / learning: 2h

Sprint fidelity score (SFS) — quick personal metric to evaluate if I hit the spirit of the week:
- +2 points if top-3 commitments completed
- +1 point per high-quality PR review (score subjective)
- -1 if >1 context switch day (>3 meetings in a block)
- Target SFS >= 3 per week

Micro-experiments (current):
- EX-01: Tiny harness that records 5 seeds / 10 prompts and snapshots token-level variance. Hypothesis: small prompt prep reduces flakiness by 30% on chat-short set.
  - Plan: create harness (this week), run baseline (w1), run mitigation (w2).
  - Measurement: fraction of samples with >8% token divergence across seeds.
- EX-02: Time-blocking experiment — 90m deep blocks vs 60m shallow. Hypothesis: 90m yields +18% throughput on code tasks.
  - Measure: PR lines changed / hour and subjective focus rating (1–5).

Risks / friction notes:
- Context switching from meetings kills momentum — flagging days to keep meeting-free mornings. Need an explicit calendar policy: "No internal meeting blocks between 09:00-11:30 on deep-work days".
- Dependence on infra events (nondet alerts) can invalidate a week's experiment data — note in journal when infra noise > 5% of time.

Decisions made this week:
- Prioritize tests that are easy to automate and cheap to run (saves iteration time).
- Move one exploratory spike to backlog until harness can snapshot determinism reliably.

Quick retrospective helpers (end of week write-up template):
- Wins: what shipped, what improved impact units?
- Misses: what blocked progress?
- Learnings: quick bullet(s) I want to remember.
- Next adjustments: commit 1–2 policy changes or micro-experiments for the next week.

Notes to future self (cheap heuristics):
- When stalled: ship a small README + an example; pressure to explain clarifies design.
- If SFS < 2 for two weeks in a row: reduce scope on commitments by 40% and re-evaluate time-blocking.

Unresolved questions / todo:
- Should I baseline the harness against the CI evaluation suite or a smaller synthetic set? (ask SRE for cost estimate)
- Follow up with Ari on whether EM can sponsor 2 hours of dedicated GPU test time for more reproducible runs.

Links & quick refs:
- Short checklist for harness (TODO): seed selection, deterministic RNG; token-variance metric; minimal docker image; smoke-test script.
- Related tickets: ENG-2147 (debug nondet alerts), PR#312 (breakdown of regression types).

End-of-week mini-retro (placeholder):
- SFS: __ /5
- Top takeaway: __
- Action for next week: __

---
Scratch notes (fast bullet stream):
- If I can get baseline results in <4 hours, expand to 50 prompts next week.
- Consider capturing a short screen recording when an infra event happens — context helps triage.
- Quick win: add a label 'micro-harness' to test runs so CJ/alerts can ignore until matured.

Last edited by Nikhil on 2025-09-02.
